newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila Central Bank offers reverse repos, T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Manila Central Bank offers reverse repos, T-bills.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Wednesday it had reopened its offering of term reverse repos and special series series T-bill after closing these facilities last Friday.
The one-month reverse repo carried an interest rate of 11.125 percent; the two months, 11.25; and the three months, 11.375.
The Central Bank's special series T-bill had a rate of 11.375 percent for the 63-day term; and 11.675 percent for the 134-day term.
Dealers said the Central Bank had closed these facilities because it was working on a skeletal force during the holidays for the Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) from November 22 to 26.
